posts.title: The new software craft
posts.description: A friend of mine is a solo nontechnical founder with a product background. For years he employed engineers in Ukraine to build his product, but he wasn’t a programmer, so he couldn’t read the code they wrote, or apply much scrutiny to their technical decisions; functionally, he had to trust their judgment on things he couldn’t verify. posts.description: When a company hits a ceiling on its core business, it often tries to grow demand. The Michelin Guide wasn’t about restaurants; it was about miles driven.
